product_metadata.title: Halter 10 Tier Free Standing Shoe Rack, Shoe Rack for Entryway, Bedroom Closet Storage Organizer, Stackable Shoe Storage Rack, Space Saving Shoe Shelf, Gray
features: Easy to Assemble - This 5 tier shoe rack organizer uses clip technology, making assembly easy and simple, while also allowing you to adjust the shelf tiers to your desired height. It's a no-hassle shoe shelf

Durable-Made with premium metal frame and a moisture-proof fabric cover this shoe shelf remains stable and doesn't wobble when used. This shoe rack is sturdy but lightweight, making it easy to carry from one place to another

Neat and Tidy- This shoe rack's quality steel plus flexible, breathable, non-toxic and non-irritating fabric cover, wipes down easily with a damp cloth, making it a great addition to your closet storage.
Space Saving- A great way to organize your home, this shoe rack frees up floor space and is a tidy way to display up to 15 pairs of shoes. It's a versatile and practical shoe stand for your closet

Dimensions-Halter's floor shoe rack organizer features a streamlined design that will easily complement your closet, bedroom, entryway, or hallway. Dimensions: 34.25 X 11.125 X 35.75 inches (LxWxH), ideal for a tricky small space.
